{{Quote|Drooga the Hutt is insane! Absolutely mad! What kind of lunatic takes his party into the Nikto Sector?|Gozubb speaks to the future Voidhound|<ref name="Nar Shaddaa Landing" />}}
'''Gozubb''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who attended a party aboard [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] luxury travel barge on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Gozubb had the misfortune of stepping out of the barge for a time to make a transaction, during which it moved to the [[Nikto Sector]], leaving him stranded on the [[Promenade]].<ref name="Nar Shaddaa Landing" />
